fields.label: Receiver canvas
fields.meaning: Physical pixel viewport, not DIP or source raster.

fields.label: Video bitrate
fields.meaning: Received video payload over the sample interval.

fields.label: Configured bitrate
fields.meaning: Configured video target, not measured throughput.

fields.label: Network loss
fields.meaning: N/A unless actually measured; TCP/render skips do not measure it.

fields.label: Audio bitrate
fields.meaning: Received audio payload over the sample interval.

fields.label: Device padding
fields.meaning: Cached native device padding; no added UI-thread query.

fields.label: Inserted silence
fields.meaning: Total plus recent sample delta, not acoustic-silence measurement.

fields.label: Discarded PCM
fields.meaning: Total plus recent sample delta, not compressed packet drops.

fields.label: A/V skew
fields.meaning: Video source PTS minus played-source audio PTS. Positive means video ahead.

fields.label: Peak observed skew
fields.meaning: Maximum absolute valid 1-Hz overlay sample in the current session/generation/playback epoch. Native diagnostic maxima remain separate.

connections.title: CONNECTIONS & QUEUES
connections.mediaQueueScope: Encoded waiting packets only, excluding dequeued/in-flight codec work. Does not alter media admission limits or inclusive diagnostic counters.
connections.mediaSpan: PTS range of the encoded waiting packets, in ms.
connections.mediaLastActivity: Monotonic age since the last valid media packet received; not queue oldest-admission age.
connections.controlLastActivity: Monotonic age since last valid control message.
connections.controlRtt: Only a matching reply to a locally generated nonce with a locally recorded send timestamp.
connections.notApplicable: Control Queued/Span and media RTT display an em dash.

platformDifferences.android: Actual MediaCodec frame-rendered callbacks; never substitute scheduled output releases.
platformDifferences.commonLimit: Neither is independent proof of physical display scanout or refresh rate.

platformDifferences.android: N/A if there is no equivalent native playback-instance counter; do not relabel audio epoch.

optionalPlatformDetails.label: Device played
optionalPlatformDetails.meaning: Includes device silence; distinct from played-source PTS.

lifecycle.enabled: Only the existing negotiated playbackStats option; no wire change.
lifecycle.idleRates: A genuine zero delta is 0; static content is not automatically unhealthy.
lifecycle.reset: Session, generation, playback epoch, counter regression, missing snapshot, retirement, hide or Stop resets rate/peak baselines.
lifecycle.nativeAccess: Typed cached snapshots only; no extra per-frame UI/JSON/logging or UI-thread native media queries.
